quarterly_data.quarter: MindWalk press release: MindWalk Reports 21% Revenue Growth and Gross Margin (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 (quarter ended July 31, 2026; Canadian dollars): revenue rose 21.3% to C$3.8 million (C$3,834 thousand vs C$3,161 thousand); gross profit rose 47.1% to C$2.2 million and gross margin expanded to 58.6% from 48.3% as cost of sales held at C$1.6 million. Operating expenses were C$8.4 million vs C$5.7 million: sales and marketing C$3.2 million vs C$1.3 million (commercial team and infrastructure for the ReefIQ launch and enterprise onboarding, including non-recurring costs), G&A C$3.9 million vs C$3.3 million (mainly non-cash stock-based compensation), R&D C$1.3 million vs C$1.0 million. Net loss from continuing operations was C$6.1 million (C$0.13 per share) vs C$4.1 million (C$0.09); adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations was C$(5,091) thousand vs C$(3,702) thousand. Net cash used in operating activities fell to C$4.0 million from C$4.2 million; cash was C$7.6 million at July 31, 2026 vs C$11.3 million at April 30, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 FY2027 revenue C$3.8 million (+21.3%); gross margin 58.6% (48.3%); net loss from continuing operations C$6.1 million; cash C$7.6 million

quarterly_data.quarter: MindWalk press release: MindWalk Reports 21% Revenue Growth and Gross Margin (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Commercial: ReefIQ, MindWalk's data platform, launched commercially in June and MindWalk is in active negotiations with multiple large pharmaceutical companies on enterprise deployments; roughly 80% of the commercial funnel by value now sits in partnership-structured engagements rather than discrete projects, spanning data management, ReefIQ and multi-target discovery. CEO Jennifer Bath: the discovery business pairs wet-lab biologics with in silico capabilities for 19 of the top 20 pharmaceutical companies; ReefIQ opens enterprise partnerships of a scale well beyond the historical recurring agreements, and new partner engagements under discussion are increasingly structured as platform partnerships in which MindWalk shares in the economics of the assets it helps create. The larger loss reflects deliberate investment in ReefIQ's enterprise rollout.
quarterly_data.figure: ~80% of the funnel by value in partnership-structured engagements; 19 of the top 20 pharmaceutical companies served
